title: Central Pike Station - Private Apt. in Mt Juliet
description:
Private apartment with dedicated covered parking, in-suite laundry, 6.8 miles to Nashville airport, 12 miles to downtown.

Whether your day is filled with visiting Nashville, remote work, outdoor adventures, visiting with family, or just passing through, then kick back and make yourself at home.

The space
Private covered parking leads directly to your front door.  

With a living room, kitchen, bathroom, laundry, and a bedroom with a comfy quality king mattress, you will find everything needed for relaxation and ease of living.

The open kitchen to living room concept is simple and cozy.  The full size kitchen includes a dishwasher and full size refrigerator and is stocked with pots and pans , etc to make a long stay more enjoyable, with the option of staying in to prepare and eat meals.  There is coffee to kickstart your morning.  

Fiber Optic WiFi ensures fast support for videos streaming and meetings with a laptop friendly workspace.

The Roku large screen television also has a DVD player and comes with a DVD library.

Guest access
The covered parking and the guest apartment are yours to enjoy.

Other things to note
To get to your private apartment you will notice the driveway forks, please stay to the right and park under the carport.
